architecture: Deterministic Video Engine with Agent Orchestration and SCORM 1.2 Packaging

modules.core/parsers/doc_parser.py: PPTX, DOCX and PDF text/notes extractor
modules.core/captions/capcut_ass.py: CapCut-style ASS dynamic karaoke captions generator
modules.core/orchestrator/video_render.py: Deterministic motion graphics card renderer with FFmpeg libass
modules.core/orchestrator/scene_builder.py: Scene generator and SCORM checkpoint aligner
modules.core/orchestrator/outro_mux.py: Stereo audio mix (-16 LUFS) and outro stitcher
modules.core/scorm/scorm_packager.py: Dual ZIP SCORM 1.2 packager for Moodle LMS
modules.core/qa/pre_render.py: Pre-Render QA validator (Chromium headless, console errors, audio sync)
modules.core/qa/post_render.py: Post-Render QA validator (ffprobe streams, silencedetect, black frame check)

invariants: 1. Checkpoints at speech end (+0.05s), never cutting voice
3. Frame resumption from frames/ on interrupted renders
4. Mandatory Pre-Render and Post-Render QA gates
5. CapCut-style animated captions active by default (opt-out with --no-captions)
6. Interactive Visual Style Preferences Menu during briefing
